# gitmoap_catalog_service_scorecards (Data Source)

Every scorecard's verdict on one service. For each scorecard that applies to the service, returns the level it reaches and how many of its checks are in each state; a check with no result yet counts as unknown. Anyone who can see the service may call it.

The token needs `catalog:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_group_by_path" "platform" {
  full_path = "acme/platform"
}

resource "gitmoap_catalog_service" "api" {
  group_id = data.gitmoap_group_by_path.platform.group_id
  slug     = "api"
  external = true
}

data "gitmoap_catalog_service_scorecards" "example" {
  service_id = gitmoap_catalog_service.api.service_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_id` (String) The service's id

### Read-Only

- `scorecards` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scorecards))

<a id="nestedatt--scorecards"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scorecards`

Read-Only:

- `counts` (Attributes) How many checks are in each state. All six states are always present. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scorecards--counts))
- `level` (String) The highest level every required check satisfies, or `null` when the scorecard has no levels
or the service reaches none of them.
- `name` (String)
- `scorecard_id` (String)
- `slug` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--scorecards--counts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scorecards.counts`

Read-Only:

- `expired` (Number)
- `failing` (Number)
- `not_applicable` (Number)
- `passing` (Number)
- `stale` (Number)
- `unknown` (Number)
